title: census.py run carries phases 0 and 1 and census.py finish carries phase 3, each as one command that stops only where a model or the operator is needed
goal: census.py run --date D [--resume] [--dry-run] runs, in order and with no agent turn between them, factdiff.py detect --sitemaps, factdiff.py apply --commit (its KB-Verified commit), census.py check --factdiff, build_index.py and the phase-1 log commit, skipping the steps whose output for D already exists on --resume, and ends by printing census.py summary with the queue block and the blocked hosts; census.py finish LOG --date D [--dry-run] runs confirm, kbdecide.py sweep, build_index.py and the confirmed-dates commit with KB-Verified, and prints the sweep's invalidation and relink lines for the report; each refuses to commit on a dirty tree outside the paths it writes and never pushes; --dry-run runs nothing that writes and prints the argv of each step. A failing step stops the run with its exit code and names the step to resume from.
